_comment_harness: Coverage is measured against the real TypeScript sources: tests/ts-loader.js installs a module.registerHooks() resolve hook so tests/test-setup.js and tests/direct-test-setup.js load main.ts and src/*.ts directly through Node's type stripping. Before that migration the sources were esbuild-bundled and the bundle's inline source map was hand-patched (tests/coverage-sourcemap.js, now deleted); statement ranges survived that remap but branch ranges did NOT — they were discarded instead of reported uncovered, so 27 of 30 files showed branches.total === 0 and only ~32 branches were measured repo-wide. `branches: 100` therefore looked like a perfect gate while verifying essentially nothing. The thresholds below are the measured floor of the direct-import harness, rounded down so the gate is not flaky. CI additionally asserts total.branches.total (see .github/workflows/ci.yml) so a harness regression that silently stops measuring branches fails the build instead of printing another false pass.
_comment_exclude: src/types.ts holds nothing but interfaces and type aliases; it erases to an empty module and is never loaded at runtime (every importer uses `import type`). Under `all: true` it would otherwise be reported as 183 permanently-uncovered lines. src/test-exports.ts is the test barrel, not product code.
